summary: UnitedHealth discloses that on February 21, 2024 a suspected nation-state actor gained access to some Change Healthcare IT systems; the Company proactively isolated those systems, causing an ongoing disruption of Change Healthcare networks and transactional services of unknown duration, while all other Company systems remain operational. Security experts, law enforcement and government agencies are engaged; financial materiality is not yet determined.
